beats.title: The dark earth
copy: Four billion years. Nothing here ever needed to be told where to go.

beats.title: Shimmer
copy: We did not begin in a place. We began in a pattern.

beats.title: The failed doors
copy: We got out far earlier than you think. It didn't take.

beats.title: Toba
copy: You've heard we almost died here. The ash says otherwise.

beats.title: The line that held
copy: This one did not go out.

beats.title: The crossing to Sahul
copy: They could not see it. They went anyway.

beats.title: The others
copy: If your ancestors left Africa, two percent of you is them.

beats.title: The world gets smaller
copy: The world got smaller. We spent ten thousand hours on beads for a child's grave.

beats.title: The sweep
copy: Someone was already here. We do not know what became of them.
Then a hemisphere in a thousand years. Behind them, the big animals stopped.

beats.title: The doors close
copy: The roads we came in on went under. There was no going back the way we came.

beats.title: Seeds
copy: In at least six places, with no contact between them, we arrived at the same answer.

beats.title: Sails
copy: Now the ocean became a road.

beats.title: You
copy: The last five hundred years moved more people than the fifty thousand before them. Most did not choose it.
Roughly two thousand generations stand between you and the one that held.
